cities.name: Yerevan
cities.local_food_tip: Lavash (flatbread), khorovats (barbecue), dolma, yogurt‑based dishes and fresh vegetables — typical Armenian flavors with rustic charm.
cities.full_day:
Morning: 🕍 Republic Square & Cascade complex — stroll through the center, admire monuments and historic architecture. → ☕ Breakfast or coffee in an old‑town café.

Afternoon: 🏛️ Visit the manuscript museum (e.g. Matenadaran) and other historic sites. → 🌳 Walk through city parks or take a short hike to nearby hills for panoramic views over Yerevan and Mount Ararat.

Sunset: 🌇 Capture sunset views from a city viewpoint or terrace, with mountains in the background.

Night: 🌃 Dinner with local dishes, perhaps live music or a visit to a cultural café — enjoy Yerevan's urban night scene.

ideas: 🌸 Strolls in blooming parks and pleasant weather for walking.
🎨 Street art, galleries, and open‑air concerts or events.
☕ Outdoor cafés and relaxed atmosphere in old‑town neighborhoods.
🏞️ Day trips into nature or countryside nearby — a break from urban heat.
🌅 Evening walks and open‑air events in warm summer evenings.
🍨 Ice cream or cool drinks after sightseeing.
🍂 Historic districts under autumn foliage — perfect for photography.
🥘 Warm traditional meals in cozy taverns as weather cools.
🏛️ Museum visits and indoor cultural activities.
❄️ Snowy streets, festive lights and winter atmosphere.
🔥 Hot soups, warm drinks and hearty Armenian meals.
🎄 Holiday markets or winter cultural events (if available).

public_transport_tips: 🚇 Use the metro for quick city travel.
🚶 Many central sights are reachable on foot — convenient for walking tours.
🚍 Buses and minibuses cover wider city areas.
📱 Check local transport apps or maps for up‑to‑date routes and schedules.

city_events.name: Yerevan Summer Nights
city_events.description: 🎶 Open‑air concerts, street performances and cultural nights under the stars.

city_events.description: 🎨 Murals, galleries, street art and creative workshops across the city.

city_events.name: Winter Holiday Market
city_events.description: 🎄 Festive decorations, local crafts, warm drinks and cozy atmosphere in the city center.

cities.name: Dilijan
cities.local_food_tip: Rustic homemade bread, simple hearty meals and natural produce — ideal after a forest walk or hike.
cities.full_day:
Morning: 🌄 Breathe in fresh mountain air — stroll through forest paths. → ☕ Breakfast in a local mountain café.

Afternoon: 🥾 A longer hike or gentle mountain trek — enjoy nature, rivers and clean air. → 🍽️ Lunch with local produce and home‑cooked dishes.

Sunset: 🌇 Hilltop or riverside viewpoint — calm nature, birdsong and serene atmosphere.

Night: 🌙 Dinner in a small tavern, possibly local music or a quiet evening under the stars — perfect for relaxation.

ideas: 🌼 Blooming wilderness, fresh scents and peaceful trails.
🍃 Light picnic near rivers or streams.
📸 Nature photography — greenery, water and mountains.
🏞️ Hiking, waterfalls and forest exploration.
🌤️ Get away from summer heat — cooler climate in the hills.
🌌 Starry nights under clear mountain skies.
🍁 Golden leaves and calm atmosphere in the forest.
🥘 Warm hearty meals after long nature walks.
🖼️ Maybe local craft workshops or cultural events.
❄️ Snowy landscapes, quiet nature and cozy indoor evenings.
🔥 Hearth‑side meals with local dishes and warm drinks.
🕯️ Peaceful night walks under crisp air and clear skies.

public_transport_tips: 🚍 Regional minibuses from Yerevan — common way to reach Dilijan.
🚶 The town and forest trails are walkable — no need for a car if you stay local.
🎒 Bring good shoes and outdoor gear for hikes and variable terrain.
🚗 If driving, check road conditions especially in winter or rainy season.

city_events.name: Forest & Nature Festival
city_events.description: 🌲 Guided hikes, nature workshops and eco‑events surrounded by forest scenery.

city_events.name: Autumn Crafts & Harvest Weekend
city_events.description: 🍂 Local food tastings, handicraft markets and calm village‑style gatherings.

cities.name: Sevan Lake
cities.local_food_tip: Fresh lake fish, local produce and simple traditional meals — perfect after a swim or boat ride.
cities.full_day:
Morning: 🌅 Early walk along the lake shore — calm water and mountain reflections. → ☕ Breakfast with lake view.

Afternoon: 🏖️ Swim or sunbathe (in summer), boat ride or lakeside stroll. → 🍽️ Lunch with grilled fish or seafood by the water.

Sunset: 🌇 Spectacular sunset over lake and mountains — great for photos.

Night: 🌌 Quiet evening by water, gentle waves, starlight — ideal for rest and reflection.

ideas: 🌼 Mild weather and calm scenery for relaxed walks.
🐦 Birdwatching and nature watching near water.
📸 Photo sessions with clear water and mountain backdrop.
🏊 Swimming, boat rides and water fun.
🛶 Fishing or boating adventures on the lake.
🌠 Evening bonfires or lakeside dinners at sunset.
🍁 Fall colors by the lake and cooler but pleasant weather.
🥘 Warm soups or stews by the water after walks.
🌙 Strolls under crisp air and quiet surroundings.
❄️ Snowy shores and peaceful, empty lakeside scenery.
🔥 Cozy meals in nearby lodges, warm drinks and calm ambiance.
🧭 Winter hikes around frozen or silent parts of the lake region.

public_transport_tips: 🚍 Regional buses or minibuses from Yerevan — common route to Sevan.
🚶 Shoreline and nearby spots are walkable — good for relaxed visits.
🛶 In summer, boat rentals are available for water excursions.
🚗 Having a car gives flexibility to explore remote beaches and lake areas.

city_events.name: Lake Sevan Summer Beach Days
city_events.description: ☀️ Beach time, boat rides, picnics and lakeside relaxation under the sun.

city_events.name: Autumn Lakeside Weekend
city_events.description: 🍂 Quiet weekends, warm food, nature walks and calm lakeside atmosphere.

cities.name: Gyumri

ideas: 🌿 Blossoming trees and pleasant climate for city strolls.
🎭 Cultural events and local gatherings as winter ends.
📷 Photography of historic facades and streets.
🏞️ Day trips to nearby nature, mountains and countryside.
🌇 Evening walks and local café visits under warm skies.
🍧 Light meals and local drinks to refresh.
🍁 Historic streets under autumn light — perfect for relaxed walks.
🥘 Traditional meals and cultural evenings in cozy taverns.
🎶 Local gatherings with music and community vibe.
❄️ Snowy surroundings, calm weather and rustic mood.
🔥 Warm meals and drinks in old cafés after cold days.
🕯️ Quiet nights under softly lit streets — peaceful and introspective.

public_transport_tips: 🚍 Regional buses connect Gyumri with other major cities — practical for travel.
🚶 The city center and historic parts are walkable — convenient for exploring.
🚗 For rural areas or nearby nature — a car helps, but check road conditions in winter.
📅 Spring or autumn are ideal for visits — mild temperatures and fewer crowds.

city_events.name: Gyumri Cultural Weekend
city_events.description: 🎭 Concerts, cultural festivals and local gatherings celebrating heritage and community.

cities.name: Tatev Monastery & Surroundings
cities.local_food_tip: Rustic dishes — local vegetables, home‑baked bread, roasted lamb, regional cheeses and simple hearty meals — perfect after mountain walks. 🍖🍞
cities.full_day:
Morning: 🏞️ Take the famous Wings of Tatev aerial tram — dramatic canyon views. → ⛪ Explore the ancient Tatev Monastery, its chapels and stone walls.

Afternoon: 🥾 Hike along cliff edges or along scenic trails to nearby villages. → 🍽️ Lunch in a village tavern: traditional dishes and local wine.

Sunset: 🌅 Watch sunset from a mountain viewpoint — monastery lights against the valley at dusk.

Night: 🌌 Stay in a guesthouse or lodge — enjoy dinner by fireplace, local music or quiet mountain night under stars.

ideas: 🌼 Alpine meadows bloom, waterfalls flow — ideal for hiking.
🕯️ Quiet, peaceful monastery surroundings before tourist season starts.
📸 Dramatic landscapes for photography — spring light and fresh air.
🏔️ Cool mountain hikes and canyon views — respite from heat.
🍃 Fresh air, rustic meals and simple rural life.
🌠 Starry nights and calm — perfect for reflection.
🍂 Golden and red foliage around monastery and hills — scenic and calm.
🔥 Hearty local meals, mountain hospitality and cozy evenings.
🛖 Immerse in village life — slower pace, tradition and calm.
❄️ Snow covering hills and monastery — mystical atmosphere.
🔥 Fireside dinners, warm local dishes, quiet nights.
🕯️ Early nights under mountain sky — peaceful and introspective.

public_transport_tips: 🚍 Minibuses from Yerevan or Goris to village near Tatev — common public‑transport route.
🚡 The aerial tram (Wings of Tatev) itself is a highlight and most scenic way to reach monastery.
🚶 Walking is often the best way to explore surrounding villages and nature trails.
🚗 For deeper countryside exploration — a car gives flexibility, but check roads especially in winter.

city_events.name: Tatev Heritage & Nature Day
city_events.description: 🙏 Traditional ceremonies, heritage tours, music and mountain hikes — celebration of history and nature.

city_events.name: Autumn Mountain & Culture Weekend
city_events.description: 🌄 Guided hikes, local food and cultural exchange in villages surrounding the monastery.

cities.name: Garni & Geghard (Temple & Monastery Region)
cities.local_food_tip: Fresh vegetables, homemade bread, local cheese and simple meat dishes — wholesome meals after exploring history and nature.
cities.full_day:
Morning: 🏛️ Visit the ancient Garni Temple — stroll among ruins and scenic cliffs. → 🚶 Walk or hike to nearby river‑canyon paths for scenic views.

Afternoon: ⛪ Explore the rock‑carved Geghard Monastery — unique chapels carved into cliffs, serene atmosphere and historic architecture. → 🍽️ Lunch in a nearby village tavern: traditional dishes and homemade bread.

Sunset: 🌅 Watch sunset over canyon cliffs and rock formations — dramatic and peaceful.

Night: 🌌 Return to Yerevan or stay nearby — enjoy local wine, cultural ambiance and reflection under mountain skies.

ideas: 🌼 Pleasant weather for archaeological tours and canyon walks.
📚 Quiet visits to historic sites before summer crowds.
🌿 Nature regenerating — green valleys and clear skies.
🏞️ Combine culture with nature: temple, monastery, canyon walks and river breeze.
🥾 Light hikes and exploration under summer sun (with shade from cliffs).
🍨 Ice cream or cold drinks in local cafés after visits.
🍂 Golden canyon views and softer light for photography.
🔥 Warm meals in local taverns after daytime tours.
🎶 Evening calm, local songs and traditional vibes near mountain churches.
❄️ Cold climate enhances historic solitude — ruins and monasteries under quiet weather.
🔥 Warm soups or stews after walks, enjoying hearth‑side taverns.
🕯️ Early twilight — ideal for reflective ruins visits and mountain night skies.

public_transport_tips: 🚍 Minibuses from Yerevan to Garni — the typical access route to the temple and nearby sites.
🚶 Exploration of ancient sites, cliffs and local villages is best done on foot or small hikes.
🚗 Car helps if you want to explore more remote nature spots or travel with flexibility.
📅 Spring or early autumn are best times to avoid heat or large crowds.

city_events.name: Ancient Heritage Day
city_events.description: 🏛️ Guided tours, storytelling, photo tours and cultural events around ancient temple and monastery.

city_events.name: Autumn Culture & Nature Weekend
city_events.description: 🍂 Combination of natural hikes, historic visits and local cuisine — perfect for reflective escapes.
